Method of Attack: Local privilege escalation via DLL search-order hijacking
Loading arbitrary unsigned DLL into a signed Symantec process running as NT AUTHORITY\SYSTEM
Bypassing Symantec Endpoint Protection's self-defense mechanism
Persistence by loading malicious code every time Symantec services start
Impacted Systems: Symantec Endpoint Protection versions prior to 14.2 RU2
Attack Vector: Exploitation requires Administrator privileges on compromised device
DLL loaded from current working directory (CWD) instead of actual location without signature validation
Indicators of Compromise: Unsigned 32-bit proxy DLL implanted in SysWow64\Wbem folder
